entities.summary: Kary H. Lasch born Kary Hermann Arthur Wilhelm Lasch on 1 February 1914 in Prague, Austria-Hungary died 27 August 1993 in Danderyd, Sweden) was a photographer who based his international model scouting network in Stockholm. He is known for his photographs of famous people like Pablo Picasso, Salvador Dalí, Federico Fellini, Sofia Loren, and Brigitte Bardot. Kary Lasch visited the Cannes Film Festival consecutively for thirty years. He also did covers for major international magazines like EPOCA of Italy, Popular Photography and many others. His humorous pictures are plentiful but less known.
